description: This file defines interfaces related to log consistency protocols in Orleans, including a protocol participant interface and a marker interface for protocol messages.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolParticipant
classes.description: Interface for grains participating in multi-cluster log-consistency protocols, providing lifecycle methods for activation and deactivation.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolMessage
classes.description: Marker interface for protocol message classes that must be serializable.

methods.name: PreActivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Method called immediately before the user-level OnActivateAsync, on the same scheduler.

methods.name: PostActivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Method called immediately after the user-level OnActivateAsync, on the same scheduler.

methods.name: DeactivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Method called immediately after the user-level OnDeactivateAsync, on the same scheduler.
